summary: Tested Clients CSV 'Import Updates Existing'. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (4 new + 5 iter19 regression). Phone match ignoring formatting, case-insensitive email match, blank cells keep old values, create, name-duplicate skip, double-match skip, staff not matched and dry_run writing nothing all work. Frontend: review dialog summary, row badges, 'Updates X: ...' line, Cancel, Confirm, list refresh, Download and the select/bulk bar all work. Issues found: (1) the success toast 'Added X · updated Y' never shows because it is swallowed by the global celebration, which shows a generic 'Saved successfully!' instead; (2) 'fields' lists unchanged values (Name always, and identical Company/Phone); (3) the preview shows the default type for update rows with a blank Type cell; (4) updates can rename a client to another existing client's name; (5) the update line is truncated in the dialog.

minor.issue: rows[].fields / changes include every filled cell, even when the value equals the current one. Name is always filled, so every update shows 'Name'. Repro: client with company 'Same' + row 'A,9333333333,Same' -> fields ['company','name','phone']. Fix: diff against the matched doc (fetch the full doc, or at least the CSV fields, in `existing`) and drop equal values. For email, compare case-insensitively.

Preview rows[].client_type is data['client_type'], which falls back to default_type when the Type cell is blank. An Associate Consultant being updated is shown as 'Sub Agent / Associate' in the review. The DB type is unchanged, so the data is correct and only the preview label is wrong. Fix: for update rows, report the matched client's existing type unless Type was filled.

The name-duplicate rule is not applied to updates. A row matching client B by phone with Name='TEST_PRB_A' (another existing client) renames B and produces 2 clients with the same name. Fix: if 'name' is in changes and differs from match name, check it against `seen` (excluding the matched client's own old name).

A filled phone cell overwrites the stored phone with the raw formatted value, e.g. '9555555555' -> '+91 95555 55555', even though it is the same number. Consider skipping phone when _phone_key is equal. Updates also don't set an updated_at timestamp.

ui_bugs.issue: toast.success(`Added ${created} · updated ${updated}`) is never shown. RCA: lib/celebrate.js patches sonner toast.success to return undefined when recentlyCelebrated() (1.6s); the axios interceptor's maybeCelebrate has just fired a generic 'Saved successfully!' for POST /clients/import. Fix: pass skipCelebration:true for the commit call too, or call celebrate({title:'Import complete', subtitle:`Added X · updated Y`}) directly.

At max-w-lg, the name and the 'Updates <old name>: Company, Name, Phone' line are truncated ('Updates TEST_UI_...') because the right-hand type/phone span takes the space. The changed fields are not readable on desktop. Fix: let the updates line wrap (remove truncate), widen the dialog (max-w-2xl), or move type/phone below.

issues: The update-fields line is truncated, so users can't see what will change
Type label is wrong for update rows with a blank Type (see backend minor)

Cancel closes the dialog and saves nothing (OldCoUI still shown)
Confirm: A company OldCoUI->NewCoUI with place Kochi kept; B place->Mumbai with phone/company kept; NEW created; list refreshed
Re-upload of the same file -> '0 new · 3 updates' (the new row is now matched by phone)
'+91 98765 43210' and '98765-43210' / '(911) 111-1111' match by last 10 digits; 'UPD_B@EXAMPLE.COM' matches 'Upd_B@Example.com'
A second row matching an already-updated client is skipped; staff-type clients are not matched from the Clients page
Download gives clients.csv; card checkbox -> bulk bar '1 selected'; Select all -> '5 selected'; clear hides the bar
action_items: Make the post-import 'Added X · updated Y' visible: skipCelebration on the commit call plus the toast, or a celebrate() with a custom subtitle
Compute rows[].fields/changes as real diffs against the matched client (skip equal values, compare phone by key and email case-insensitively)
For update rows, show the matched client's existing type in the preview when the Type cell is blank
Apply the duplicate-name check when an update renames a client to another existing client's name
Stop the update line in the review dialog from being truncated
critical_code_review_comments: routers/clients.py is ~580 lines; the import logic (header map, row parse, match/diff) could move to lib/client_import.py
`existing` projection only has id/name/phone/email, so a real diff isn't possible; fetch the CSV columns too
by_phone/by_email dict comprehensions keep the last of any duplicate existing phones silently; acceptable but undocumented

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 tests; 4 minor logic issues found by probes)
